newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Koebnick says German CPI to remain steady.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Koebnick says German CPI to remain steady.

text.p: Inflationary pressures in Germany are likely to remain modest in the coming months, a senior Bundesbank official said on Wednesday.
"In the foreseeable future and well into the next year, there are no inflationary dangers," council member Hans-Juergen Koebnick told Reuters in an interview.
Koebnick, also president of the state central bank in the Rhineland and Saar regions, added "everything is indicating that prices will remain at their low levels."
West German inflation in September rose 1.4 percent on the year but fell 0.1 percent on the month.
